description: Source code for the ShuffleExternalSorter class in Apache Spark, responsible for sorting, spilling, and writing shuffle data to disk during sort-based shuffle operations.

classes.name: ShuffleExternalSorter
classes.description: Handles sorting, spilling, and writing shuffle data for sort-based shuffle in Spark.

methods.name: writeSortedFile
methods.description: Sorts in-memory records and writes them to disk, optionally counting metrics for final output.

methods.name: spill
methods.description: Triggers a spill of current in-memory data to disk in response to memory pressure.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Calculates current memory usage of the sorter.

methods.name: updatePeakMemoryUsed
methods.description: Updates the peak memory usage statistic.

methods.name: getPeakMemoryUsedBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum memory used so far.

methods.name: freeMemory
methods.description: Frees all allocated memory pages and resets memory counters.

methods.name: cleanupResources
methods.description: Deletes all memory and spill files, used for error handling.

methods.name: growPointerArrayIfNecessary
methods.description: Grows the pointer array if needed, spilling if unable to expand.

methods.name: acquireNewPageIfNecessary
methods.description: Allocates a new memory page if current page is insufficient.

methods.name: insertRecord
methods.description: Inserts a record into the sorter, spilling if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: closeAndGetSpills
methods.description: Finalizes sorting, writes remaining data, and returns spill file info.
